query: Can a car that broke down on its way to the grid before the start still start from the grid?
answer_1:
The passages do not directly answer this. None of them covers a car that breaks down on its way to the grid.

The closest rules concern cars that are already on the grid. Under B5.7.2, cars starting from the grid must return to the grid at the end of the formation lap and stop within their starting grid positions [3]. Under B5.11.1, during a standing start all cars must be stationary in their allocated grid position when the start signal is given [2].

Article B5.5.6 deals with a different case. A car that has stopped on the grid and is then moved to the Pit Lane Inner Lane or the Competitors Designated Garage Area before the formation lap cannot return to the grid before the TTCS starts. If it is able to, it must start from the Pit Lane [1].
